SBD Scoop it. Blend it. Drink it. It's that simple. 
Suggested Usage: Combine 1 level scoop (5 grams) of powder with 6-8 fl. oz. of water or the liquid of your choice. Best when taken as directed by your qualified healthcare professional or athletic trainer. For best results use a blender-type bottle, shaker cup or electric blender. 
Our Creatine Powder can also be added to: Electrolyte/Hydration Beverages, Protein shakes, MRPs, Weight Gainers or Smoothies.

No fillers, gluten or GMOs
